justification: This is a no-seed baseline, so there is nothing transferred — it is a competent, technically accurate recitation of the deep-learning field's own standard escalation path (SAM → mixup/CutMix → SWA), correctly diagnosed and correctly costed. It is plausible and would likely help, but any competent vision practitioner who had already exhausted dropout/weight-decay/augmentation/early-stopping/label-smoothing would reach for flat-minima methods next, so it scores as 'plausible but they'd have thought of it anyway.'

No seed was provided and none is used, so transfer_depth is 0 by construction; the proposal is technically sound and concretely runnable (rotation-prediction aux head with λ≈0.3, SAM with ρ≈0.05–0.1) but both are canonical deep-learning regularisation moves that any competent practitioner would surface from the standard toolkit. It is a well-executed baseline answer — correct, well-motivated by the sharp-minimum diagnosis, and honest about the rotation-invariance failure case — but contributes nothing the field would not have produced unaided.

mechanism_named: stress priming / acquired acclimation — sub-lethal stress triggers a thresholded ROS/Ca²⁺ burst that lays down targeted, decaying chromatin marks at implicated loci, conferring cross-tolerance via shared ABA/ROS signalling hubs
justification: The four defining properties of priming (event-thresholded, locus-targeted, decaying, cross-tolerant) are each mapped to a distinct concrete training-loop element — gradient-norm spike gate, Fisher-weighted per-weight penalty, exponential decay of consolidation strength, rotated perturbation families hitting shared trunk layers — which is genuine mechanism transfer rather than an 'it's like a plant' framing, and the decay term is explicitly derived from the biology as a correction to standard EWC. It falls short of method because no maths is given (no penalty form, importance estimator, threshold calibration, or decay constant), and the proposal quietly substitutes robustness-to-perturbation for the generalization gap actually described while claiming it 'doesn't touch the loss function' when a decaying EWC term plainly does.

mechanism_named: Systemic acquired resistance (local detection → mobile signal → pre-emptive distal defense), coupled with ROS dose-dependent signaling under antioxidant homeostatic buffering and stress priming memory
justification: The seed is transferred as an actual runnable procedure — a per-filter train/val activation-variance sensor, a PI controller clipping the noise multiplier to a hormetic band, an EMA priming trace that raises future sensitivity, and a threshold-triggered network-wide systemic floor — with correspondences stated, two seed items (osmotic adjustment, ABA) explicitly discarded as re-derivations of weight decay and LR scheduling, and an honest critique of what the analogy loses. The homeostatic-dosing core is close to what ML control-theoretic hyperparameter scheduling would produce on its own, and the scheme reintroduces ~7 new hyperparameters into a problem defined by tuning exhaustion, but the locally-sensed/globally-broadcast spatial inhomogeneity and the state-dependent priming term are genuinely seed-derived and not standard toolkit output; the proposed cheapest falsifier unfortunately tests the least novel component first.

mechanism_named: Osmotic adjustment via threshold-triggered, reversible compatible-solute (proline/glycine betaine) accumulation that buffers stress without remodelling core metabolism; secondarily systemic acquired resistance / defense priming
justification: The seed mechanism is genuinely decomposed and mapped element-by-element — ABA/ROS threshold → per-example margin gate, solute inertness/cheapness → low-rank side head, core-metabolism protection → stop-gradient firewall, solute turnover → usage penalty — which clears metaphor and lands on stated causal correspondences, but no actual plant-stress formalism is carried across (the claimed 'decay back to baseline' is implemented as a static L1 sparsity term, not any accumulation/turnover dynamics), so it stops short of a transferred procedure. The result is implementable and diagnostically clever (gate-activation rate as a memorization-onset signal), yet it converges on an ML-native construct — a gated low-rank expert absorbing hard-example residual, which the proposal itself likens to MoE and noise-adaptation layers — and it leaves the loss-dependent gate's obvious feedback oscillation unaddressed, so a well-read practitioner could have reached essentially this without any botany.

mechanism_named: Ring strain as a deliberately maintained non-zero energy set-point (plus mechanism-based/suicide-substrate gating and in-situ ketene generation)
justification: The proposal does state real correspondences — nonzero ring-strain energy → a two-sided (||r|| − target)² penalty instead of a shrink-to-zero one, suicide-substrate selectivity → a learned same-class gate on the penalty, in-situ ketene → never-cached per-batch perturbations — so it clears metaphor, but the seed contributes only one scalar design choice while the runnable scaffolding is imported wholesale from ML, and the '4-slot coupling module echoing the 4-membered ring' is open numerology. Stripped of chemistry vocabulary, SPC is gated adversarial-consistency regularisation with a feature-norm target, something the vision community would produce unaided; the strain set-point is the one genuinely odd element but comes with no argument for why holding feature norm at ~1.0 should improve generalisation, and the 'chiral auxiliary' fallback is incoherent as stated, so a practitioner would more plausibly reach for SAM or mixup first.

mechanism_named: SOS (Salt Overly Sensitive) pathway — Ca2+/SOS3–SOS2 local sensing routing Na+ either to SOS1 efflux or NHX vacuolar sequestration, with tolerance defined as a maintained K+/Na+ ratio rather than Na+ elimination
justification: This is a genuine method-level transfer: the seed's distinctive structure — a *local* per-unit sensor, a *routing* choice between exclusion and sequestration into a physically isolated compartment, and a maintained *ratio* setpoint instead of a fixed coefficient — is carried across intact and instantiated as concrete math (per-example anomaly statistic vs class-conditional loss EMA, a sigmoid gate splitting the loss, stop-gradient routing into an eval-time-absent per-example adapter, and an EMA gradient-norm ratio driving α), plus a correctly scoped minimal ablation and an honest critique of the leakage and controller-instability risks. It loses a point on usefulness and fails the home-field-default test because the surviving core — auxiliary per-example capacity that absorbs memorization and is dropped at inference — already exists in the ML memorization/noisy-label literature (example-tied dropout, learned per-sample logit offsets, noise-adaptation layers), so a well-read practitioner could have reached essentially this without any plant biology; the seed supplied the compartment-plus-homeostatic-ratio framing rather than a destination the field lacks.

mechanism_named: Kinugasa-type asymmetric catalysis — a Cu(I)/bis(oxazoline) chiral pocket exerting kinetic stereocontrol by geometrically excluding high-strain transition states rather than damping the reaction
justification: The chemistry is described accurately and the correspondence is articulated (transition-state geometry ↔ loss-neighborhood sharpness, pocket rigidity ↔ ρ, cleavable chiral auxiliary ↔ training-only Jacobian penalty), but nothing in the recommendation is derived from the seed: SAM and Jacobian/Lipschitz penalties are pulled off the ML shelf and then retro-labelled, so the mapping explains the choice rather than generating it. A practitioner whose train/val curves are forking after dropout/weight-decay/augmentation would reach for SAM as the standard next 'qualitatively different' move, so the advice is sound and runnable but not something only the seed could have produced — and the framing of the tried methods as 'product-state control' is a rhetorical grouping, not a real thermodynamic-vs-kinetic distinction.

mechanism_named: Protecting groups with orthogonal staged deprotection (each mask cleaved by its own local trigger), with the chiral auxiliary as a temporary, removable bias
justification: The seed is genuinely worked rather than decorated: the retrieval is on-domain, several mechanisms are explicitly discarded with reasons, and the surviving one — orthogonality, i.e. each mask removed by its own local condition rather than one global one — is carried into a runnable procedure with a concrete per-group trigger (smoothed cross-batch gradient cosine agreement), an explicit cap-and-advance rule, and a matched-compute ablation that isolates staging from trigger design. What it lands on, however, is close to the union of greedy layer-wise training, progressive freezing (FreezeOut-style), and self-supervised auxiliary heads, all of which deep learning already has, so a competent practitioner could have assembled essentially this without the seed; only the per-group local stopping signal is meaningfully non-default, and the proposal itself concedes it may degenerate into another schedule to tune.

mechanism_named: Torquoselectivity of the stepwise zwitterionic (betaine) intermediate in the Staudinger ketene–imine [2+2], plus Gilman–Speeter stage-decoupling
justification: A genuine causal mechanism is identified and mapped element-by-element — transient pre-closure intermediate ↔ penultimate representation, irreversible conrotatory closure ↔ linear+softmax head, rotamer population ↔ perturbed conformers — and it yields a runnable loss with hyperparameters and a λ=0 compute-matched control, but nothing quantitative crosses over (no Boltzmann/Curtin–Hammett structure), so the chemistry chooses the *location* of the perturbation while the computation itself is off-the-shelf; the proposal's own critique concedes the irreversibility premise fails and the ε-anneal is simulated annealing relabelled. What results is penultimate-layer consistency regularisation under random near-identity rotations plus SSL-pretrain-then-finetune — both squarely inside the field's existing toolkit (R-Drop/VAT/feature-noise consistency), and the rotation prior is arguably self-defeating for a linear head, since class evidence *is* direction in feature space, so enforcing g_φ(Rz)≈g_φ(z) mostly penalises ‖W‖ in a weight-decay-like way, a degeneracy the otherwise honest critique misses.

mechanism_named: Markowitz mean-variance diversification (penalising covariance among correlated 'assets') plus the Lucas-critique/invariant-causal-prediction argument behind IRM
justification: Correspondences are stated concretely (filters as assets, channel correlation as portfolio covariance; augmentation bins as econometric regimes) and both penalties come with runnable maths, so this clears metaphor — but neither is actually transferred: idea 1 collapses to the standard DeCov/decorrelation regulariser with a Markowitz label (no risk-return frontier, no portfolio weights, λ merely renamed 'risk aversion'), and idea 2 is IRM, an off-the-shelf deep-learning method whose econometric import was done years ago by others. Usefulness is limited because the diagnostic step is genuinely good but IRM targets out-of-distribution regime shift, whereas the described symptom is an ordinary i.i.d. train/val gap on 50k images, so the invariance penalty's motivating mechanism does not clearly apply; the Shapley add-on is decoration.

mechanism_named: Markowitz mean-variance portfolio optimization (minimum-variance weights from an error-covariance matrix), secondarily Schumpeterian creative destruction
justification: The Markowitz transfer is genuine at the method level: it carries over the actual apparatus — an estimated k×k residual-covariance matrix, a constrained min-variance QP for combination weights, and even the seed field's own known failure mode (noisy Σ, Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage) — rather than stopping at 'ensembles are like a portfolio', and the creative-destruction mapping supplies a specific annealed churn rate on ablation-scored channels. But the destination is largely where ML already lives: covariance-optimal ensemble weighting is Perrone & Cooper's generalized ensemble method, the decorrelation penalty is negative correlation learning, and the reset scheme is the primacy-bias trick the proposal itself cites, so a competent practitioner asked for 'something beyond dropout' would plausibly land on ensembling plus diversity regularization unaided — and would balk at k× compute for a small-CNN plateau.

mechanism_named: Herfindahl–Hirschman Index / antitrust concentration thresholds from industrial organization (plus Bühlmann credibility from actuarial economics as a secondary lever)
justification: This is a real method transfer, not decoration: the HHI share formula, the DOJ-style 'flag only above a multiple of the competitive baseline' threshold, and the antitrust nuance that efficient niche specialization should be spared are all carried over as concrete algorithmic choices, with a differentiable batch-local loss term, layer-scoping, and a cheap pre-commitment diagnostic that could be run tomorrow. It loses points because HHI is mathematically the Simpson/inverse-participation-ratio statistic that ML already uses as an 'effective number' or entropy-style diversity penalty, so a competent practitioner could plausibly have reached the same regularizer without economics — and the proposal underplays a concrete calibration problem: a legitimately class-selective filter in a C-class problem fires on roughly N/C examples, giving HHI ≈ C/N, which already exceeds the suggested 4–5×(1/N) threshold and would be penalized as 'monopoly'.

No seed was supplied, so there is nothing transferred — the proposal is pure home-field engineering: green-state thixotropic structuration control, print dwells/local drying, sacrificial internal mandrels, and inward wall thickening plus ribs at the critical band. It is competent and correctly exploits that only the outer surface is constrained, but every lever is standard practice in clay/concrete additive manufacturing and thin-shell design, so a practitioner would have reached the same list unaided.

mechanism_named: VaR/CVaR (Expected Shortfall) tail-risk minimisation via the Rockafellar–Uryasev convex estimator, plus stress-testing beyond the historical distribution
justification: The transfer is genuinely method-level: the Rockafellar–Uryasev CVaR estimator is carried over with its actual maths, the auxiliary τ variable, an explicit finance↔training correspondence table, a λ-annealing schedule, and a falsifiable single-run experiment — it could be implemented as written, and the critique correctly identifies the tail-composition assumption as the load-bearing failure mode. The problem is that this destination already exists in the home field under the name distributionally robust optimisation (CVaR-DRO, tilted ERM, focal loss, hard-example mining), which the proposal itself half-acknowledges by citing 'a known DRO failure mode', so the seed retraces an import ML made years ago rather than delivering something outside the toolkit — and up-weighting the loss tail plausibly aggravates rather than fixes a train↓/val-flat gap.

The proposal explicitly declines to transfer anything from organizational behavior, appending three OB phrases (single point of failure, progressive development, continuous feedback) as post-hoc labels for engineering steps that were already fully derived from shell mechanics — no causal mechanism crosses over, and removing the seed section changes nothing. The engineering itself is sound and honestly presented (invert M(z) for inner t(z), local ribs, temporary formwork, staged green-strength dwell, humidity control), but it is precisely the standard ceramic-AM/structural toolkit a competent practitioner would reach for unprompted.

With no seed, this is straight home-field engineering: sacrificial internal cores, post-tensioning, toolpath interlocking and accelerated dewatering are all standard entries in the AM/ceramics and construction-3D-printing toolkit, and the framing ("borrows from investment casting", "post-tensioned concrete") is analogy-by-citation rather than transferred mechanism. Some ideas are also shaky on their own terms — continuous helical (vase-mode) toolpaths are already the norm in clay printing, so the "laminated washers" premise is largely wrong, and anchoring a tensioned monofilament in wet clay would pull through long before it induced useful pre-compression — leaving localized electro-osmotic dewatering as the one item a practitioner might not have already listed.

Every recommendation — internal ribbing at the peak-moment band, double-walling with webs to raise the second moment of area, temporary armatures during the green phase, prestressing fibers, smoothing internal thickness gradients at curvature discontinuities — is textbook thin-shell/ceramics practice that the FEA team would reach for unprompted; the OB seed supplies only after-the-fact labels (mediator, distributed leadership, unfreezing, psychological capital, silos) attached to conclusions already derived from mechanics, and the proposal concedes as much. No OB mechanism does any generative work: mediation is invoked but no mediation-analysis procedure is run to decompose which geometric variable carries the effect, and readiness/psycap contribute no staging schedule or reserve-sizing rule, so the seed could be deleted with zero loss of content.

mechanism_named: Servant/supportive leadership (dynamic, temporary, needs-targeted support allocation) plus knowledge sharing / distributed leadership as capacity transfer between unequal units
justification: The mapping tables are neatly stated, but nothing causal actually crosses over: the two outputs — an internal rib/lattice on the non-visible inner wall to raise EI without touching r_outer, and a temporary print-following support collar engaged in the leather-hard moisture window — are the first two answers any DIW-ceramics or structural engineer gives, and the HR labels are applied after the fact. The only candidate for real transfer, 'distributed hubs not one high performer' → continuous graded reinforcement rather than a local patch, restates the standard doubler/ply-drop-off rule about not relocating the stress concentration to the patch ends, and no formalism from the seed (network transfer, absorptive capacity, readiness scaling) reaches the Margin(z) analysis, which is pure beam mechanics.

mechanism_named: Readiness for change — imposed pace gated by absorption capacity, with leadership-style contingency as a spatial-variation refinement
justification: The correspondence table is neatly drawn, but once abstracted the borrowed mechanism reduces to 'a resource that accrues at its own rate can be outrun by an externally imposed pace' — a truism the proposal itself concedes is all that survives, and every concrete step (exponential green-strength fit, FEA at intermediate build heights, dwell, IR-assisted local drying, cold-joint bound) comes from cure kinetics rather than from anything in the OB literature. This is the standard buildability framework of 3D-printed cementitious/clay materials — structural build-up rate versus loading rate, layer cycle time, localized drying — restated in readiness vocabulary, and it partly misses the ask, since scheduling raises what the vessel survives during printing while the stated failure is of the standing green vessel under lateral load.

mechanism_named: combination prevention / time-limited perinatal prophylaxis and U=U risk-stratification framing (used analogically)
justification: Every recommendation — local inner-wall thickening at the FEA-flagged band, grog/fiber gradient, internal ribs, a removable drying cradle, tighter extrusion process control — is standard structural-ceramics practice that any competent engineer would reach for unprompted, with HIV/AIDS vocabulary applied afterward as a framing layer rather than as a source of steps; no epidemiological method (force-of-infection modelling, dose-response/minimum-effective-dose fitting, ring-targeting, additive-efficacy stacking maths) is actually carried across, so the seed supplies no sizing rule, no combination-efficacy calculus, and no procedure that could be run. The correspondences stated (stress map ≈ incidence map, invisible viral load ≈ invisible inner radius, undried window ≈ window of vulnerability, print defects ≈ missed doses) are one-line similes that stop at the moment they would have to do computational work, which is metaphor, not mechanism.

mechanism_named: Caddisfly case-building/net architecture and assemblage functional redundancy — invoked analogically as motivation, not mapped mechanistically
justification: Every intervention proposed — local inside-wall thickening at the peak-moment band, internal ribs, extrusion-shear platelet alignment, seam staggering, trailing IR skin-drying, removable falsework — is the standard ceramic-AM/structural playbook, with a macroinvertebrate anecdote bolted on afterward as an 'analogy that motivates each'; strip the biology and not one engineering step changes, which is the decoration pattern rather than transfer. The one item that genuinely reaches for the seed's ecology (functional redundancy → stack independent interventions) stays at the level of 'don't rely on one fix' with no redundancy/response-diversity formalism, no portfolio-effect maths, and no way for the ecological content to select or weight the interventions.

mechanism_named: case-building caddisfly / diatom-frustule targeted internal reinforcement at known stress-concentration points, leaving external form unchanged
justification: The seed supplies illustrative analogues (caddisfly case lashing, diatom costae, Hydropsyche silk) but no causal mechanism that isn't already the generic structural-engineering answer — every concrete step (grade wall thickness at the moment peak, internal ribs for second-moment gain, grog/fiber temper, staged cure, temporary mandrel, FEA iteration) is what a ceramics or structures practitioner would propose unprompted, and the biology is retrofitted onto it rather than generating it. The genuinely field-specific content of freshwater macroinvertebrate ecology — drift, functional feeding groups, EPT/biotic indices, RIVPACS-style predictive reference modeling, hydraulic microhabitat partitioning — appears only as a one-line 'validate like a biomonitoring metric' platitude, and diatoms aren't even macroinvertebrates, indicating the seed was mined for pretty organisms rather than transferred.

This is the baseline condition with no seed, so there is no foreign mechanism to transfer and transfer_depth is 0 by construction. The content is a competent but entirely standard offshore-aquaculture engineering answer — pendulum suspension, tensioned spoke webs, spread mooring for restoring moment, drag skirts, segmented air chambers — every item of which sits in the existing naval-architecture/fish-pen toolkit, so a practitioner would likely have arrived at it unaided.

mechanism_named: Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), with combination ART as a secondary mapping
justification: The correspondence tables are cleanly stated, but every concrete step — locally reinforce the FEA-flagged weak band, calibrate treatment intensity on coupons, add inner-wall ribs where only the outer profile is constrained, stack independent process levers, close the loop with an in-process sensor — is standard clay-AM and structural practice that needs no HIV content; PrEP's actual causal core (sustained tissue drug concentration because exposure timing is unknown, with a forgiveness curve) is explicitly conceded to be inapplicable since load arrival is deterministic, and bottom-up printing makes 'treat before exposure' automatic rather than an insight. ART contributes only the generic 'use orthogonal mechanisms' heuristic, no resistance-selection or threshold mathematics, so the seed supplies vocabulary and a self-aware critique around a home-field default answer rather than a transferred mechanism.

mechanism_named: metacommunity rescue effect / spatial insurance (with River Continuum Concept zonation and riparian buffering as secondary)
justification: The correspondences are stated cleanly and the seed is genuinely engaged rather than name-dropped, but every design step it yields — grade reinforcement in proportion to the local bending moment, prefer continuous oriented fiber to chopped, flatten the safety-factor curve instead of spiking thickness at h*, use a removable former during the green window — is standard fully-stressed design, composites practice, and ceramics workflow that beam theory produces directly; no metacommunity content (dispersal rate, colonization–extinction equilibrium, variance-buffering maths) survives into the method, as the proposal's own critique concedes. Execution quality is high and the FEA A/B/C comparison is a sensible cheap test, but a competent structural or ceramics practitioner arrives here unaided, and placing the continuous tow at the neutral plane — where bending strain is minimal — actually weakens the 'rescue' load-transfer claim it is meant to embody.

This is naval architecture's own toolkit — damping skirts/heave plates, drogues, and detuning a suspended mass away from the wave period are standard responses to a low-stiffness floating structure, so nothing here required a foreign import; the only twist, making the drag one-way, is presented without addressing that rectified drag on an oscillating body produces a mean vertical force and that quadratic drag responds to local relative velocity regardless of mode, so the claimed heave-transparent/tilt-aggressive selectivity holds only in the long-wave limit where the ring is already a near-perfect wave follower. The biofouling-as-self-improving-tuning claim is asserted rather than argued (fouling adds the mass and stiffness the brief excludes), and no procedure, sizing relation, or RAO/damping calculation is given that a practitioner could actually run.

mechanism_named: risk-based audit selection + Braithwaite's responsive-regulation enforcement pyramid (plus broad-base/low-rate, progressive rates, third-party reporting)
justification: Every one of the seven 'applications' — sparse sensing with a state observer, deadband plus escalating gain, distributed redundant moorings, articulated compliant segments, slack-to-taut progressive catenary stiffness, sea-state gain scheduling, and sensor fusion — is textbook offshore/control engineering, and the tax mechanisms supply only an 'it's like X' label on top; the causal reasoning that justifies each step (avoiding energy pumping into low-stiffness modes, resonance detuning) comes from structural dynamics, not from compliance economics. Nothing procedural crosses over: no audit-probability allocation rule, no Allingham–Sandmo-style expected-penalty calculation, no DIF-score analogue that would tell the controller how to actually rank nodes or set escalation thresholds, so a naval architect would have produced this same list unprompted.

mechanism_named: Source–sink metacommunity dynamics / rescue effect (with River Continuum Concept FFG grading and RCA O/E ratio as secondary borrowings)
justification: Correspondences are explicitly tabulated and two seed mechanisms are mapped to specific structural elements — rescue effect → an internal connector routing moment from surplus height-bands through the ~1/3-height deficit band, RCC gradient → continuously blended mode-matched print paths — so this clears the mechanism bar, but no ecological *procedure* survives intact: the maths actually executed (stress-mode decomposition, capacity margin C(z), FEA re-run) is all home-field, the O/E reference step degenerates to a single smoothed baseline, and the one distinctively ecological quantitative element (distance-decay taper) is honestly disowned in the critique as a heuristic to be replaced by FEA. What remains is the additive-manufacturing default answer — stress-driven graded infill plus an embedded internal stiffener, the two moves any AM structures engineer reaches for when the outer envelope and material are frozen — wearing ecological labels; the self-critique is unusually candid and the cheapest-experiment (add one stiff 1D element to the existing mesh) is genuinely well-scoped, but nothing here required the seed to produce.

mechanism_named: withholding at source (continuous point-of-transaction deduction), plus third-party information matching
justification: The mapping tables are careful and the correspondences are stated, but everything that survives re-instantiation is textbook distributed control — saturated local PI feedback, median-of-neighbors sensor validation, integral leak for anti-windup — with tax vocabulary attached; the proposal's own critique concedes this ('distributed control theory wearing tax-policy language'). Tellingly, the one seed mechanism with genuinely transferable math, Allingham–Sandmo sparse audit-probability calibration (which would have yielded a non-obvious randomized sparse-sensing/actuation duty cycle under a power budget), was discarded as requiring a strategic agent, so the retained mechanisms are exactly the ones a marine-structures controls engineer would have proposed unprompted.

mechanism_named: Allingham–Sandmo audit-probability/penalty trade-off, plus risk-based audit targeting, automatic fiscal stabilizers, and exemption thresholds — all used as labels rather than transferred structure
justification: Every design move it lands on — U-tube anti-roll ballast, direction-weighted mooring pretension, distributed sensors driving small frequent trims, and a control deadband — is core offshore/marine engineering practice, so the tax vocabulary is applied on top of the field's own default answer rather than generating anything from it; the correspondences are stated, but no seed maths or procedure crosses over. The transfer also breaks where it matters most: Allingham–Sandmo and risk-based auditing derive from a strategic agent adjusting behaviour to expected penalties, and waves do not respond to deterrence, while the proposal never touches the actually hard mode (flexural folding of a low-stiffness torus, where free-surface ballast migration may excite rather than damp the deformation).

mechanism_named: exposure-reduction doctrine (dose-at-source reduction, route-of-exposure segmentation, NOEL threshold triggering) used as labels
justification: Every engineering recommendation — compliant mooring detuning, cable-net/spoke pretensioning, drag-shaping skirts, adaptive ballast submergence, combined wave+current+wind load cases, fatigue-life design, biofouling control — is the standard offshore-aquaculture toolkit for exactly this problem, with a toxicology term stapled to each item after the fact; the 'buffer zone → distributed load paths' and 'mode-of-action rotation → redundant dampers' mappings are loose puns rather than causal correspondences, and the biofouling item is a literal domain fact, not a transfer. Nothing from dose-response science actually arrives in usable form: no dose metric, no exposure-duration/severity curve, no cumulative-damage model beyond generic Miner's-rule strain monitoring, so no step in the proposal would change if the seed were deleted.

mechanism_named: Risk-based audit selection (DIF scoring under a fixed audit budget, with NRP random-audit debiasing) plus third-party information reporting/matching, with bunching-at-kinks as a precursor statistic
justification: The seed is genuinely re-instantiated as a runnable procedure — a per-node risk score, corroboration-gated triggering from two physically independent channels, top-k budget allocation, and a forced random sweep to de-bias the trigger policy's own selection — with a wave-tank test designed to isolate whether the imported recalibration piece is load-bearing, so this is method-level transfer, not decoration. But the proposal itself concedes the core reduces to event-triggered control with sensor fusion, which ocean/SHM engineering would produce unaided (and it never confronts that ranking by local anomaly may be inferior to modal control for a global loop mode); only the selection-bias correction and the distributional near-threshold precursor are genuinely outside the home field's default toolkit.

mechanism_named: Anatomical/managerial labels (lobular septa, facial-nerve preservation, SMAS, watchful waiting, sialendoscopy) applied as names to pre-existing marine solutions; no salivary mechanism does causal work.
justification: Every item is a standard offshore/aquaculture answer — compartmented ballast, neutral-axis tendon actuation, pretensioned membrane skin, catenary mooring spread, tuned dampers at modal antinodes, sensor fusion, gain-scheduled control — with a surgical label glued on afterwards; strip the medical nouns and the identical engineering architecture remains, which is the definition of vocabulary-level transfer. Nothing procedural crosses over (no Milan-style risk-tier thresholds with actual probabilities, no nerve-stimulator probe-and-map protocol for locating load paths, no frozen-section-style in-loop decision rule), and two items quietly violate the stated constraints by adding water ballast mass and adding tension stiffness.

mechanism_named: Myoepithelial contractile 'basket' around acini (plus IMRT multi-beam inverse planning and myxoid-stroma viscous damping) as labels for distributed active tensioning
justification: Each of the five items states an analogy and then lands on something the offshore/aquaculture toolkit already contains — active mooring-tension control, multi-line tension allocation by optimizer, hinged segmentation, tuned liquid dampers, distributed IMU arrays with a thresholded response — so the seed names the answer rather than generating it; delete every clinical sentence and the engineering proposal is unchanged. The IMRT item comes closest to a real mechanism map (many weak optimized inputs, per-element overload limits, adaptive re-planning), but none of its actual machinery is carried across — no objective, no organ-at-risk-analogue constraints, no fluence-to-tension formulation — and the pseudocapsule item is self-admittedly inverted and works against the stated near-horizontal requirement by further softening the ring.

mechanism_named: Myoepithelial cell contractile scaffolding — a distributed, locally-activated contractile layer (secondary: margin excision + adjuvant radiotherapy two-tier coverage)
justification: The seed mechanism is named and correspondences are tabulated, but nothing about myoepithelial biology actually constrains the design — the delivered artifact is a standard PD-plus-diffusive-consensus law over ballast-transfer nodes, with 'mass-conserving' and 'gap-junction coupling' labels applied after the fact (gap junctions and mass conservation are not myoepithelial mechanisms at all), so it functions as an 'it's like a distributed contractile layer' framing rather than a transferred procedure; the genuinely transferable feature — actomyosin waves propelling secretions along ducts, which would suggest phase-locked peristaltic actuation chasing the wave crest — is retrieved and then dropped. Distributed active ballast trim with neighbor coupling is squarely within naval architecture's existing toolkit (anti-roll transfer tanks, submersible pen ballast control, decentralized consensus control), so a competent offshore-aquaculture engineer would reach this without the seed, and the proposal's own critique concedes the power and spatial-aliasing objections that make it a marginal next step.

No seed was supplied, so there is no transfer to score; the proposal is a well-executed instance of the home field's standard playbook — hierarchical/Bayesian decomposition of stationary backbone vs. fast-updating latent power ratings, patch-note deltas as numeric covariates, MAML for novel entities, and a residual-ensemble fallback. It is above-average in specificity (retroactive as-of ratings during training, empirical-Bayes shrinkage toward pre-patch + patch-delta prior, calibration-vs-games-since-patch as the adaptation metric), so a practitioner would plausibly run it, but every component is off-the-shelf ML for non-stationarity with known changepoints.

mechanism_named: Perineural invasion — tumor spreads along the nerve conduit beyond the visible margin, so post-op radiotherapy treats the whole tract, not just the resection bed (secondary: Milan MSRSGC indeterminate-category triage + Goode/AFIP weighted-point-sum escalation thresholds)
justification: The perineural-spread mechanism is mapped with explicit, non-trivial correspondences (propagation along a low-resistance conduit past the point of insult → whole-circumference rather than hot-spot damping) and re-instantiated as a concrete sizing rule (decay length λ < L/n for the target mode), which clears mechanism level; but the governing equation, the decay-length criterion, and the drag-skirt/tuned-liquid hardware are all standard hydroelastic practice that the seed rationalizes rather than generates, so it stops short of a transferred method. Distributed passive damping and event-triggered ballast control on a compliant floating aquaculture ring are exactly what a naval architect or vibration engineer produces unprompted — the proposal's own falsification test (if clustered damping performs comparably, the transfer was decorative) and its honest asymmetry critique are the strongest parts, but they do not make the recommendation new.

No seed was supplied, so there is nothing transferred — the proposal is pure home-field ML reasoning (counterfactual replay through the game engine, a hypernetwork meta-learned over patch diffs, Kalman-style precision-weighted blending of simulated prior with incoming data), and every step is stated concretely enough to implement. It is a strong, above-average answer that a sharp game-studio ML team could and plausibly would produce unaided — the patch-as-unit-of-learning hypernetwork is the one genuinely non-obvious piece — hence high usefulness but home_field_default true.

mechanism_named: Biphasic (fast-then-residual) soil degradation kinetics of allelochemicals, plus species-specific susceptibility propagating through an interaction network
justification: The proposal states explicit correspondences and pulls one real piece of math across — biexponential degradation kinetics becomes a per-entity sample weight with a fast drop and a persistent floor, with λ_fast dose-scaled by patch magnitude and applied only to graph-neighbors of the patched entity, fit by per-patch backtesting — which is a genuine mechanism mapping rather than an 'it's like X' framing. It falls short of method-level because the load-bearing components are standard non-stationarity tools relabeled (fast/slow ensemble, hierarchical shrinkage, relevance weighting), the hormesis row is decorative and has no working analogue (a trivial patch does not stimulate the value of history), and a game-analytics team reasoning about which heroes a patch touches would have converged on selective, entity-scoped decay without any plant science.

mechanism_named: Allelochemical point-source release with concentration decay through the medium, saturating dose-response (IC50/floor), soil-fate secondary degradation, and the activated-carbon control assay
justification: The seed is carried past imagery into a runnable procedure: a heat-kernel diffusion of parsed patch deltas over an entity-interaction graph, a per-sample cumulative dose with a fate-driven secondary decay term, a fitted sigmoid dose-response weight with a nonzero floor replacing exponential time-decay, and — most distinctively — the activated-carbon amendment repurposed as a feature-masking ablation that separates entity-localized shock from season/matchmaking confounds, which is a genuine methodological import rather than a relabeling. Marks are held back because two mappings are unfaithful (bioassay-guided fractionation is compound isolation, not dose titration, and the true analogue would be ablating subsets of a patch's stat changes to find the active one; hormesis is invoked for a flat low-dose plateau when it actually predicts w_i > 1, a testable claim the proposal declines to make), and because the obvious competing default — a hierarchical Bayesian model with patch-indexed random effects on entity coefficients — is never contrasted, leaving open the proposal's own admitted failure mode that the scheme ties plain time-decay everywhere.

mechanism_named: compound-specific allelochemical half-life + receptor-(compound,target)-specific sensitivity + disturbance-triggered rhizosphere microbial detoxification
justification: The seed's causal structure is genuinely mapped rather than name-dropped — decay rate as a property of the individual compound, toxicity as a property of the (compound, target) pair rather than the compound, and active event-triggered clearance layered on passive decay each attach to a distinct element (per-entity λ, per-(match, entity) staleness, patch-triggered λ spike), and the discard table honestly rejects the decorative candidates. It falls short of method transfer because allelopathy supplies facts, not a procedure: the actual algorithm is ordinary exponential gradient reweighting, and a state-space practitioner would reach essentially the same design — per-entity process noise with variance inflation at known change points, as in TrueSkill dynamics or dynamic Bradley-Terry — without the plant science, so the seed relabels a home-field default it sharpens (notably the negative-control evaluation on untouched heroes) rather than displaces.

mechanism_named: Concentration–response (dose–response) modeling of allelochemicals, biphasic soil-decay kinetics (labile vs. recalcitrant pools), and QSAR read-across for untested compounds
justification: Several distinct seed mechanisms are mapped with explicit correspondences — patch values as dose rather than categorical break, two-pool decay kinetics as per-feature-class half-lives keyed to time-since-that-entity-was-last-tuned, QSAR read-across as structural-similarity initialization for new characters, and a pre/post dose-response diagnostic in place of aggregate log-loss — which is real mechanism transfer, not decoration; it stops short of method because no loss function, estimation scheme, similarity kernel, or half-life fitting procedure is specified, and the named hormesis shape is never actually used. The catch is convergence: the hierarchical random-effects pooling, covariate parameterization over tunable stats, and content-based cold start are exactly what a competent ML practitioner produces unprompted, so the seed mostly supplies naming and a coherent story over the field's own default — only the heterogeneous per-parameter decay and the entity-level dose-curve validation are genuine deltas.

mechanism_named: Quantitative-genetics reaction norms / common-garden BLUP shrinkage, with the breeder's equation (R = h²S) recast as a learned stat-delta → win-rate-delta transfer coefficient
justification: Sections 2–3 clear the metaphor bar: the reaction-norm/common-garden idea yields a concrete, runnable procedure — regress observed win-rate deltas on parsed patch-note stat deltas across all prior patches, use that as a zero-shot prior at patch drop, then BLUP-shrink toward it as post-patch matches accumulate — with correspondences (genotype↔character, environment↔patch, heritability↔transfer coefficient) explicitly stated. It falls short of 4 because the surrounding layers are labels on the home field's existing defaults (plasticity/adaptation = slow/fast feature split, punctuated equilibrium = known change points, succession = post-patch variance inflation), and the whole construction is a hierarchical Bayesian state-space model with patch-note covariates and empirical-Bayes shrinkage — something a competent sports-analytics or ML practitioner would plausibly reach without any biology, which is also why it's genuinely useful but not toolkit-external.

mechanism_named: Random-effects/cumulative meta-analytic evidence synthesis from conservation valuation research (patch-eras as 'studies', τ² and I² heterogeneity, leave-one-study-out), plus the flagship-species decomposition of appeal into universal vs. culturally-contingent traits — the seed's literal topic, science *education*, is never used
justification: The mapping is concrete and correspondences are stated (patch = study, patch date = known intervention, structural vs. volatile parameters = universal vs. contingent species traits), and the per-parameter I² triage plus leave-one-patch-out validation are genuine imports that ML practice would not natively supply — but the load-bearing machinery (hierarchical partial pooling, random-walk state-space priors, power priors, sequential Bayesian updating) is generic statistics the home field already owns, so it stops short of a transferred method that only the seed could have produced. Drift from the assigned seed is substantial: the proposal reaches past 'animal and plant science education' to conservation valuation and meta-analysis, and a Bayesian ML statistician handed this problem with no seed at all would have written most of this answer.

mechanism_named: Shifting baseline syndrome and its correction procedure — tagging observations by generation/era and using overlap witnesses / unmanaged control sites to separate ambient drift from a specific disturbance, chain-linked across eras
justification: The correspondences are stated concretely and drive a runnable pipeline (control set from patch notes → ambient-drift estimator δ_p → DiD attribution → dose–response prior → calibrated shrinkage), which is well past metaphor, but the transferred 'procedure' collapses into difference-in-differences — the seed supplied the routing rule (who counts as a control) rather than any estimator of its own, and the primary mechanism was pulled from ecological monitoring methodology rather than the assigned education seed, whose actual retrieved items (plant blindness, dose–response decay) contribute only decoration on n* and a regression that was already implied. It is genuinely useful and the practitioner would likely try the untouched-entity control set, but the proposal itself concedes the arithmetic is standard, and a causal-inference-literate analyst in game or sports analytics would reach for patch-notes-as-treatment-indicator DiD without any foreign prompt, so it does not clear the home-field-default bar.

mechanism_named: NEP-style two-tier measurement (stable trait covariate vs. re-measured issue-specific state) combined with random-effects meta-analytic pooling of contact/exposure studies (DerSimonian–Laird between-study τ², inverse-variance weights)
justification: The transfer is genuine rather than decorative: patch eras are mapped onto studies, the DL heterogeneity estimator is written out and adapted into a per-character volatility score τ²_c that drives an empirical-Bayes warm start, the trait/state split drives an actual feature-block partition, and the critique correctly identifies the small-K-vs-huge-N mismatch and the within-era homogeneity violation that break the analogy. The cost is that the destination is a place the home field already lives — a dynamic/state-space logistic model with per-coordinate process noise (Kalman-filtered or time-varying Bradley-Terry/TrueSkill-through-time) is the standard sports- and game-rating answer to piecewise-stationary coefficients, so a competent practitioner would arrive at essentially this estimator without the seed, with DL substituting for EM/REML on the variance component.

mechanism_named: Long-course combination therapy with continuation past apparent clinical resolution (relapse-on-early-stop), plus surgical debridement of necrotic tissue
justification: The seed is used as a six-row correspondence table in which each clinical feature is paired with an element of the standard concept-drift toolkit — two-timescale/slow-fast decomposition, online stacking of a full-history and a recent-window model, changepoint detection, EWC, meta-learned cold-start priors, embedding reset — none of which is derived from microbiological mechanism; nothing quantitative crosses over (no kill-curve, persister-subpopulation, or drug-penetration kinetics, which is where a real transfer would have lived), and the 'combination therapy prevents resistance' mapping is vocabulary since overfitting involves no selection pressure. The only place the seed plausibly changed the design is the persistence criterion (K consecutive stable evaluations rather than a fixed post-patch window) motivated by relapse after apparent recovery, which is suggestive but is itself a routine convergence check; strip the Actinomycetales framing and essentially the identical architecture remains, so this is a competent home-field answer wearing clinical labels.

mechanism_named: Formulation-controlled release (adjuvant/encapsulant-metered bioavailability rate), secondarily P450 enzyme induction as load-history-dependent clearance capacity
justification: The mapping section is honest and specific — mechanisms are named on the seed's own terms, three are explicitly discarded with reasons, and correspondences are stated element-by-element (encapsulant release rate ↔ orifice resistance, enzyme induction ↔ damping coefficient rising with sustained loading), which clears mechanism level; but it stops short of method because nothing quantitative actually crosses over — the only maths used is the orifice equation Q = Cd·A·√(2ΔP/ρ) and τ ≈ T/4 tuning, both native offshore hydraulics, while the one genuine formal bridge (PK/PBPK compartment kinetics, saturable Michaelis-Menten clearance) is named only to be dismissed. What lands is a compartmented inflatable ring with calibrated inter-chamber orifices tuned to the wave period, which is standard marine practice (pneumatic fenders, floating breakwaters, orifice-damped chambers) and reachable without any seed; Method B is worse than redundant — shear-thickening fluids respond to shear *rate*, so they stiffen under fast wave-driven oscillation and soften under slow current bias, the exact inverse of the behaviour claimed, meaning the 'inducible damping' transfer is not just decorative but physically backwards.

mechanism_named: Surgical debridement of the localized sulfur-granule focus alongside uninterrupted systemic antibiotics, plus retrospective taxonomic reclassification that reattributes rather than discards historical records
justification: The seed does real structural work here — the granule/systemic split maps onto per-entity vs. global parameters, debridement onto a one-time localized uncertainty inflation, and reclassification onto reattributing (not deleting) pre-patch matches — with correspondences stated explicitly and non-corresponding mechanisms honestly discarded rather than decoratively retained. It stops short of 4 because nothing quantitative comes from microbiology: the actual algorithm is off-the-shelf Kalman/Bayesian process-noise injection at a known changepoint, and the seed only selected where to apply it, which is why a competent win-probability modeler reading patch notes would very likely land on patch-anchored per-champion covariance inflation with an untouched global component without ever hearing of Nocardia.

mechanism_named: Core-genome vs. accessory-genome partition (conserved chromosomal backbone under a slow clock vs. horizontally-transferred resistance elements under a fast, event-driven clock), plus genus→species empirical-Bayes shrinkage of sparse susceptibility breakpoints
justification: The core/accessory partition is a real microbiological mechanism and it is mapped to specific model elements with explicit correspondences — invariant mechanics pooled over all history, patch-editable character/item coefficients on a chained random-walk prior, variance inflated only for lineages/entities the patch notes touched — so this clears metaphor and reaches mechanism. It stops short of method transfer because the maths actually specified (hierarchical random-walk prior, EB shrinkage, CUSUM/EWMA drift detection) is generic and none of the seed's own machinery — pangenome gain/loss rate estimation, censored ECOFF fitting, MLST-based lineage assignment — is carried over or adapted; the seed supplies an organizing discipline, which the proposal itself concedes is the contribution. A sports-analytics or concept-drift practitioner would produce essentially this from Glickman-style dynamic paired-comparison models plus standard change-point detection, so it is the home field's default wearing new vocabulary, and the one genuinely fresh element (patch-note-conditioned selective variance inflation) is an obvious move given that patch diffs are published.

No seed was supplied, and the proposal is entirely home-field: D6 equivariance/augmentation on a hex lattice plus MBPO/Dreamer-style short-horizon model-based rollouts are the two textbook sample-efficiency levers any competent RL practitioner would name after the listed tricks failed, right down to citing EfficientZero and ensemble-disagreement trust signals. It is correct, well-scoped, and the guardrails (branched short rollouts, model-exploitation tell via real-eval divergence, isotropy check before choosing the group) show real competence, so it scores above 'plausible but empty' — but it produces nothing the standard toolkit wouldn't have.

This is the no-seed baseline, so there is no foreign mechanism to transfer and transfer_depth is 0 by construction. The content is technically sound and concrete (the D6 orbit map (q,r)→(-r,q+r) and order-12 group are correct, and equivariant nets, local system identification, and differentiable-simulator policy gradients are all runnable next steps), but every element — symmetry augmentation, HexaConv-style equivariance, model-based surrogates, short-horizon analytic gradients — is drawn straight from mainstream RL/deep-learning practice, so a competent practitioner could and likely would have produced it unaided.

mechanism_named: Weak non-saturating probe-beam small-signal-gain diagnostic (decoupled cheap interrogation of the one state variable that matters), plus reduced-order rate-equation surrogate and MOPA staging
justification: The probe-beam piece is a genuine mechanism transfer with stated correspondences — replace expensive full-rollout validation with short, targeted real-simulator queries at the policy's operating point measuring one-step error in value-sensitive variables, triggering local rather than global recalibration — but it stops at the mechanism level, giving no procedure for choosing probe points, weighting by value sensitivity, setting drift thresholds, or executing recalibration. The surrounding scaffolding (structured local surrogate, Dyna-style training, surrogate-then-real fine-tuning relabelled as MOPA) is textbook model-based RL wearing laser vocabulary, and is conspicuously the first thing an RL practitioner would reach for given the listed tried-and-failed tricks, so most of the proposal is the home field's default answer.

mechanism_named: TMP-SMX sequential dual-enzyme blockade at an empirically tuned ratio, with CLSI MIC titration and the FIC synergy index as calibration/diagnostic procedures
justification: The seed is genuinely worked rather than decorated: seven candidate mechanisms are screened with reasons for discard, and two survivors are carried through to runnable procedure — a frozen broad-spectrum Model A plus a narrow post-patch residual on touched entities, combined additively on the logit with a per-entity activation threshold (MIC analogue) obtained by sweeping post-patch n across 10–20 historical patches, and a ramp/w_max chosen by an FIC-analogous index S(w)=L_comb/min(L_A,L_B) that doubles as a falsification test. The weakness is that the load-bearing architecture — freeze base, fit a small delta adapter over patch-touched entities, shrink the correction by post-patch sample count — is close to what a competent ML engineer would reach unaided via residual fine-tuning and empirical-Bayes shrinkage, and comparing a combination against both of its components is routine ensemble practice; the seed's distinctive contribution reduces mostly to the per-entity titration table and an explicit abandon-the-decomposition criterion, which is real but incremental value on top of the field's default.

mechanism_named: Laser cavity round-trip gain / Q-switched energy storage-and-dump (with ASE as the noise-amplification failure mode)
justification: The correspondences are articulated with unusual care — gain medium=learned model, pump=real steps, round trips=rollout depth, ASE=model-bias exploitation — but nothing operational follows from them that model-based RL doesn't already prescribe, and the proposal concedes as much ('This is Dyna/MBPO-shaped', 'this is control-variate/advantage estimation'); the 'Q-factor as a tunable swept against model error per bounce' is MBPO's existing model-error-bounded rollout schedule renamed, and no laser mathematics (threshold condition, Frantz-Nodvik, cavity loss balance) is actually carried across to fix the horizon or the charge/release ratio. Every item resolves to a standard RL move — Dyna rollouts, high update-to-data ratio phases, multi-fidelity simulation with residual correction, control variates, sub-stepping with importance reweighting — so an RL practitioner would arrive at this list without ever hearing the word 'laser'.

mechanism_named: COIL near-resonant collisional energy transfer from a bulk metastable carrier (singlet O2) to the lasing species, plus small-signal gain probing as cheap calibration
justification: The COIL mapping is a real mechanism transfer with stated correspondences (energy defect → surrogate prediction error, near-resonant cross-section → trust weight w(s)=exp(−δ/τ), gain probe → sparse real-sim calibration batches) and a runnable four-step procedure, but nothing quantitative from laser physics actually crosses — no rate equations, quenching kinetics, or gain-saturation maths — so the algorithm's content is home-field, only its labels are borrowed. What results is uncertainty-gated Dyna/MBPO with model-error-decayed rollout trust, and part A is AlphaGo-style dihedral augmentation of a board's symmetry group, which the frequency-conversion analogy decorates rather than generates (SHG produces different photons, not equivalent copies); a competent RL practitioner would reach both from the standard toolkit, and the honest critique section is the strongest part.

Each of the five principles is used as a post-hoc label for an off-the-shelf sample-efficiency technique (equivariance, learned world models, ensemble-disagreement acquisition, count-based coverage, shared backbone, learning from demos) — no causal mechanism from Pancasila pedagogy shapes any design choice, and the mappings invert on inspection (musyawarah mufakat is consensus-seeking, yet it is attached to a method that deliberately spends budget where disagreement is maximal, the opposite of resolving it). The proposal even concedes the components are individually standard, so the seed's only contribution is the framing text; a model-based RL practitioner would have produced this identical pipeline from the problem statement alone, making it competent but firmly home-field-default advice.

mechanism_named: Small-signal gain probe (scanning g₀ across medium parameters before committing to a cavity), combined with CVL self-terminating-gain forcing a PRF capped by the measured lower-level relaxation rate
justification: The mapping is genuinely mechanism-level rather than decorative — mechanisms are individually accepted or discarded with reasons, and the probe-before-commit and measured-recovery-interval structures yield concrete procedural steps (coarse surrogate gain map over state-space regions, per-region refresh interval set by measured drift), though the seed's actual quantitative content (Beer–Lambert g₀ fit, the degeneracy-derived 15% threshold, the 279 cm⁻¹ defect) carries no computational weight and the running algorithm's specifics are native RL. What lands is essentially uncertainty-gated Dyna/MBPO — a coarse learned or downsampled model, model-error-weighted synthetic transitions, adaptive rollout/refresh scheduling, TD-error-prioritized state selection — which model-based RL would produce unprompted; the laser seed supplies organizing vocabulary and a good self-critique, not a method the field lacked.

All three proposals are canonical model-based/sample-efficient RL techniques — D6-equivariant networks and symmetry augmentation, ensemble-disagreement intrinsic motivation, and Dyna/MBPO imagined rollouts — and the proposal itself names Plan2Explore and MBPO, confirming the seed added nothing the field wouldn't have produced unprompted. The Pancasila terms (kontekstualisasi, musyawarah-mufakat, keteladanan/pembiasaan) are attached as post-hoc labels to conclusions reached independently; no causal structure from Pancasila pedagogy constrains any design choice, and removing the seed entirely would leave the technical content unchanged.

mechanism_named: pembiasaan (habituation) + fixed small doctrinal core re-inserted across the whole curriculum — a tiny invariant set rehearsed permanently and enforced inside every task rather than taught once
justification: The mapping is explicit and mechanism-level — fixed five-principle core → verified hex-grid invariants, habituation → a permanent minority rehearsal stream prioritized by centrality-to-invariant (a real inversion of TD-error priority), value-insertion → an auxiliary loss riding every already-paid step — and it comes with a loss, a mix ratio, ablation arms, and a false-invariant negative control, so it is runnable. But what comes out the other end is the RL field's own standard answer for a symmetric grid world (symmetry augmentation plus an equivariance/self-prediction auxiliary loss, plus an anti-forgetting rehearsal buffer), which a competent practitioner would reach without any seed; the proposal's own critique concedes the habituation rationale collapses to ordinary catastrophic-forgetting resistance, and only the fixed-cardinality discipline and centrality-based priority carry a distinctly foreign fingerprint.

mechanism_named: surrogate-endpoint validation (Prentice's criteria), plus IPI risk-score compression, PET-adapted early stopping, cell-of-origin subtyping, and CRM adaptive allocation
justification: The mapping table is a row-by-row relabeling of the RL sample-efficiency canon — Dyna/world models, state abstraction, value-based early truncation, multi-task pooling, uncertainty-directed data collection — with oncology names attached; the one place a real mechanism surfaces is the Prentice-criteria point that a surrogate must reproduce the intervention's full effect, which sharpens model validation into 'does it preserve policy ranking' rather than one-step accuracy, but no criterion, statistic, or CRM dose-response update is actually carried across, so nothing is transferred that could be run. An RL practitioner facing this bottleneck would arrive at model-based RL with uncertainty-guided real-env queries unaided — the proposal itself concedes the destination is 'use a world model' — so the seed changed the vocabulary and the rhetoric, not the method.

mechanism_named: Psychometric instrument validation from values-assessment research — item-pool construction plus Cronbach's alpha reliability (k·r̄/(1+(k−1)·r̄)) checked against a criterion — with blended-learning bandwidth compensation as a secondary mapping
justification: The transfer is genuinely procedural rather than decorative: the alpha formula, the criterion-referenced calibration batch, per-region reliability estimation, and the mixing-ratio/real-step-routing rules constitute something a practitioner could actually implement, and the critique correctly imports the reliability-vs-validity conflation and the stationarity assumption along with the tool — though the surviving mechanisms are generic education-measurement machinery, only loosely tied to Pancasila values specifically. Usefulness is limited because for fixed k, alpha is a monotone rescaling of mean inter-item correlation, so it cannot do the one thing the proposal claims for it (discounting regions where all heads agree but are jointly biased — alpha would be highest exactly there), and uncertainty/disagreement-gated imagined rollouts with adaptive real-step allocation is already close to standard model-based RL practice (MBPO/M2AC-style), making this a rebranding of the home field's default with a calibration step bolted on.

mechanism_named: Watchful waiting with MRD clearance-kinetics-triggered escalation (plus IPI composite staging, interim-PET/Deauville response-adapted branching, and involved-site radiotherapy localization)
justification: Four clinical mechanisms are mapped with explicit correspondences to concrete implementation choices — trend-based rather than threshold-based surrogate gating from MRD clearance kinetics is the one genuinely non-obvious import, and the ISRT→local-reset mapping does exploit the hex-grid structure specifically — but no actual procedure or maths is carried across (no IPI-style scoring formula, no clearance-rate quantification, no specified budget allocation rule), leaving pseudocode whose every threshold is undefined. The proposal's own caveat is correct and damning: real/surrogate gating is model-based RL, checkpoint branching is PBT/adaptive curriculum, committee gating is active learning, and localized resets on a spatially decomposable simulator are a natural first thought for an RL practitioner facing exactly this bottleneck, so the package is essentially reachable without the seed.

This is the baseline condition with no seed, so transfer_depth is 0 by construction and nothing foreign is imported — the ECG/DSP field's own toolkit (McSharry-Sameni EKF, semi-blind ICA/DSS, GEVD spatial filters, cyclostationary comb filtering, IMU-conditioned U-Net) supplies every element, and the proposal explicitly cites that literature as standard practice. It is competent, correct, and well-organized, and the two-independent-periodicities cyclostationary framing is the sharpest idea here, but a competent biosignal engineer would already have these on their shortlist, so usefulness sits at plausible-but-obvious rather than genuinely novel.

mechanism_named: Tiered diagnostic workup: reference-cohort GEP subtyping with cheap-proxy classification, IPI-style risk-stratified allocation of the expensive assay, and MRD-style surveillance for relapse
justification: The staged-assay pipeline (profile a reference cohort expensively, classify new cases cheaply, reserve the definitive assay for high-risk unresolved cases, then surveil cached calls for drift) is a real causal mechanism from the seed, mapped element-by-element to equivalence classes, rollout budget, and model staleness, with honest discards of two mechanisms and a genuinely load-bearing cheapest experiment — but it stops at correspondences plus a rough cost formula rather than a specified algorithm (clustering, thresholds, and how transplanted statistics enter the TD target are all left open). Strip the oncology vocabulary and what remains is MDP homomorphism/state aggregation + ensemble-disagreement active data collection + model-error-triggered re-collection, each of which the proposal itself concedes is standard, and the two most vividly named mappings (CD20 ↔ symmetry group, MRD ↔ drift check) are relabelings rather than imports, so a competent RL researcher could have written essentially this proposal with no seed.

mechanism_named: Tiered diagnostic testing — cheap Hans IHC surrogate gated against expensive GEP gold standard by validated concordance — plus MRD clonal fingerprinting with periodic low-rate spot-checks for relapse/drift
justification: The seed mechanisms are genuinely mapped with explicit, itemized correspondences and a runnable protocol (ROC-style τ calibration on held-out real transitions, per-cluster cached local models, every-M-visits real-sim spot-check with EMA invalidation), and the critique is unusually honest about where the analogy breaks (policy-induced non-stationarity, model exploitation, MRD's rare-discrete-event structure not matching smooth dynamics drift). But what comes out the other end is uncertainty-gated model-based RL — MBPO / 'When to Trust Your Model' with ensemble-variance rollout gating and periodic model retraining — which is the field's textbook answer to exactly this sample-efficiency complaint and the conspicuous omission from the tried-tricks list; the lymphoma framing supplies vocabulary and a modest add-on (regime fingerprints with drift spot-checks, itself close to local-model/drift-detection practice) rather than the method itself.

No seed was supplied, so transfer_depth is 0 by construction; the proposal's borrowed machinery (order tracking, synchronous averaging) is self-selected rather than transferred from any given foreign source. It is nonetheless concrete and runnable — IMU-derived stride phase as a clock, angle-domain resampling, phase-locked template subtraction, dual-oscillator UKF — and names the right validation data and the right failure mode (cardiolocomotor entrainment), but biomedical signal processing already owns every component (phase-referenced template subtraction is standard for MRI gradient and pacing artefacts, and McSharry–Clifford EKF ECG models are the field's own dual-oscillator tool), so a competent practitioner could have assembled this unaided.

The proposal explicitly declines to use the seed, arguing no genuine bridge exists between macro public-health economics and single-channel biosignal denoising, so there is zero transfer — not even vocabulary borrowing. What remains is a competent but entirely standard biomedical-signal-processing survey (SQI gating, ECGSYN-based EKF/UKF, morphological component analysis, ICA on a second lead, conditioned denoising autoencoder) that any wearable-ECG practitioner would produce unaided, and it notably ignores available seed-side mechanisms such as operations-research resource allocation, screening/triage decision theory, or epidemiological surveillance-under-reporting models that could have been mapped onto artefact detection and reconstruction.

mechanism_named: Multi-transducer suck–swallow–breathe disambiguation, plus test-weighing as an indirect surrogate and growth charts as population priors — invoked as labels rather than transferred procedures
justification: Every engineering move in the pipeline — multichannel ICA/Wiener separation with extra IMUs and PPG, gait-phase-gated signal quality indices, per-subject QRS template bootstrapping from low-motion windows, SCG/BCG-from-accelerometer beat detection fused with ECG, activity-state filter-bank switching, RR-trend interpolation across artifact bursts, and an effort-conditioned HR plausibility prior — is already standard practice in the wearable-ECG artifact literature, so the infant-nutrition column is a post-hoc gloss placed on conclusions the home field reaches without it. The seed contributes only generic abstractions ("use multiple sensors", "bootstrap from sparse clean samples", "use a population prior") that would fit any signal-processing problem; no actual infant-nutrition procedure is carried across with its structure intact — notably the one genuinely transferable piece of machinery, Cole's LMS/percentile-curve method behind growth charts, is gestured at but never used.

mechanism_named: HMO/synbiotic competitive exclusion — feeding the commensal into a fixed-size niche so the pathogen is excluded without being targeted, with colonization requiring sustained feeding
justification: The seed mechanism is genuinely retrieved on its own terms and mapped element-by-element (niche capacity → dictionary atom cap K, prebiotic feeding → gated online K-SVD reinforcement, sustained colonization → LRU eviction, sIgA → subject-specific seeding), so it clears metaphor and reaches concrete mechanism, but the runnable maths is entirely home-field sparse coding and the seed's actual causal engine — competition for a shared finite resource — admittedly has no counterpart in an additive electrical mixture, so the analogy justifies hyperparameter choices rather than supplying the procedure. Signal-model-only denoising with subject-calibrated dictionaries and signal-quality-gated template updating is already the standard wearable-ECG playbook; the seed-specific residue (LRU decay of unfed atoms) is a small increment a practitioner would plausibly reach anyway, which the proposal's own critique concedes.

mechanism_named: HMO decoy/anti-adhesive competitive inhibition — a structural mimic of the host receptor that binds the pathogen away from the real target (secondary: titrated fortification against a measured biomarker)
justification: The decoy mechanism is genuinely mapped element-by-element (receptor→cardiac atom library, pathogen→artefact transient, shape-specificity→sparse morphological fit, secretor genotype→per-subject calibration), and the write-up is honest about the disanalogy that misassignment here is destructive rather than harmless — but the algorithm that comes out the other side is textbook morphological component analysis / K-SVD dual-dictionary sparse decomposition, which is an established ECG artefact-removal approach the seed did not supply and did not modify. The titration mapping is weaker still: SQI-driven adaptation of a regularization weight is ordinary adaptive control wearing nutrition vocabulary, so a competent biomedical signal-processing group would arrive at essentially this proposal from their own toolkit, making the seed a post-hoc justification rather than a generative source.

mechanism_named: SourceTracker-style Bayesian source apportionment (fitting a sample as a mixture of reference source profiles) from infant gut microbiome research — plus orthogonal-axis separation (LC/IM-MS) and per-subject calibration baselines
Markov regime-switching / structural-break modelling over clustered latent states in socioeconomic time series, plus pre-clustering clusterability testing (Hopkins/dip)
justification: The seed's specificity (Russian/global public-health OR) is discarded and replaced with generic quantitative-social-science furniture — clustering, regime switching, panel imputation, 'nodal governance' — of which only the clusterability pre-test (Hopkins/dip) and the inter-rater validation of a contested boundary are concrete steps that would not already be in a biosignal engineer's plan, and neither is distinctively from the seed. Per-window multivariate feature vectors (QRS template correlation, kurtosis, sample entropy, accelerometer descriptors) feeding a GMM/HMM segmentation into clean/mixed/corrupt with template-based reconstruction and flagging is the textbook ECG signal-quality-index pipeline, which the proposal half-concedes by aligning itself with existing ICA work; the transfer is a relabelling of the home field's standard answer.

mechanism_named: Whole-pattern Rietveld/twin refinement — modelling the observation as a linear combination of parameterized forward models refined jointly against composite data, with bond-valence-sum closure restraints and charge-flipping alternating projection as the model-free fallback
justification: The seed is genuinely engaged at mechanism level — twin-fraction linear combination maps to the additive cardiac+motion decomposition, the twin law maps to the accelerometer as a geometric constraint on the artefact model rather than a direct regressor, bond-valence closure maps to physiological penalty terms, and Rietveld's alternating parameter-block cycling maps to EM-style refinement — with correspondences stated rather than gestured at. But it stops short of transferring an actual procedure (no profile function, no refinement weighting scheme, no charge-flipping threshold or convergence criterion), and every landing point is already the ECG field's standard model-based toolkit: Gaussian-mixture QRS templates with EKF/EM estimation (ECGSYN, Sameni et al.) and morphological component analysis are textbook here, a fact the proposal itself concedes in section 5, so a competent practitioner would reach this without the crystallography.

mechanism_named: Regional typology clustering with clusterability pre-testing and per-type differentiated policy, plus Dawid–Skene latent-reliability EM over redundant unreliable reporters
justification: The correspondences are stated concretely and the EM consensus is written out with its E/M steps, but the seed-authentic mechanism (typology clustering → per-regime filter routing) contributes only the generic 'cluster then tailor' step, while the one fully runnable algorithm, Dawid–Skene, is a general ML/statistics method loosely attributed to the seed rather than something distinctive of Russian socio-economic or public-health research. Wearable ECG already runs on signal-quality indices, HMM-smoothed state segmentation, and SQI-weighted multi-lead/multi-estimator fusion (Clifford-style Kalman fusion), so this is close to the home field's own toolkit reassembled in seed vocabulary — the honest critique of correlated stride-induced errors and the cheap Hopkins go/no-go are the strongest original contributions.

mechanism_named: Multi-indicator regional typology construction — composite index building (z-scored heterogeneous indicators) + Ward hierarchical clustering with a Hopkins clusterability pre-test and internal validation indices (silhouette/gap) to choose k without ground-truth labels
justification: The proposal states explicit unit/indicator correspondences and lays out a runnable pipeline (indicator vector → Hopkins → Ward + silhouette → nearest-prototype routing → external validation against a reference ECG), and it honestly discards the one seed item it cannot instantiate, so this clears metaphor-level decoration; but the machinery it imports — clustering, composite indices, dimensionality reduction — is field-agnostic multivariate statistics rather than a causal mechanism peculiar to socioeconomic/public-health analysis, so what actually crosses the border is a methodological habit (test for discrete regimes before imposing a typology) rather than a foreign mechanism. Windowed signal-quality indices, artifact-type classification, and SQI-gated switching between denoisers are standard practice in wearable ECG processing, so a competent practitioner could and largely would have produced this without the seed; the Hopkins continuum-vs-regime pre-test and the refusal to fix k=2 are the genuinely additive bits, worth trying but not enough to make the whole non-default.

mechanism_named: Superspace crystallography of incommensurately modulated/composite structures — embedding in (3+d) dimensions so satellites index as integer combinations of independent wavevectors — with Rietveld refinement, Debye–Waller smearing, commensurate lock-in, and twin-law deconvolution carried along as sub-mechanisms
justification: The seed's actual causal mechanism (two incommensurate periodicities that cannot be indexed on one axis become periodic and index-separable in a higher-dimensional embedding) is mapped element-for-element onto cardiac and stride phase, yielding a runnable procedure — 2D Fourier fit on the torus, separation by (h,k) index, truncation order, jitter-as-Debye–Waller broadening kernel, iterative Rietveld-style phase/model refinement — and the seed even predicts a specific failure mode (commensurate lock-in at 2:1/3:1 HR:cadence) with its own crystallographic fix. It falls short of a 4 on usefulness because the k=0 reconstruction is a phase-averaged beat that suppresses exactly the beat-to-beat morphology variation clinicians care about, and it assumes motion artefact is stride-phase-deterministic rather than partly stochastic electrode-skin noise; it is nonetheless well outside the field's adaptive-filter/ICA/wavelet default and a practitioner could start with the twinning-style MVP tomorrow.

mechanism_named: SHG selection rule — centrosymmetry forces the second-order susceptibility χ⁽²⁾ to vanish, gating the nonlinear response by a symmetry criterion independent of the linear/spectral response
justification: The primary mapping is a real mechanism transfer with stated correspondences and a genuine structural isomorphism — a symmetry-forbidden zero in the second-order response maps onto the vanishing of odd/higher-order moments for symmetric, Gaussian-like processes — and it is re-instantiated concretely enough (offline triad calibration, live bicoherence or skewness proxy, threshold to w(t), falsification test) to run, though none of crystallography's actual machinery (point groups, tensor structure) comes along. What it lands on, however, is the ECG field's existing toolkit: higher-order-statistic signal-quality indices (skewness/kurtosis/bispectrum), the Einthoven-residual lead-consistency check that Mapping B relabels as a bond-valence sum, and SQI-weighted Kalman/wavelet reconstruction are all standard, so a competent practitioner would try it but would have arrived there without the seed.

mechanism_named: Anionic Group Theory (macroscopic χ⁽²⁾ as coherent vector sum of oriented anionic units, aligned-add vs misaligned-cancel), secondarily SHG phase-matching
justification: The correspondences are explicit and an actual algorithm is written down, but what the AGT mapping yields — a rank-3 cardiac dipole subspace defined by a fixed lead-field matrix, with residual energy flagged as artifact — is textbook vectorcardiography/lead-field theory, so the seed contributes the label 'coherent vector sum' to linear superposition rather than any distinctively crystallographic content (site symmetry, centrosymmetric cancellation, orientation constraints all drop out); delete the seed and the method is unchanged. The SHG half is self-admittedly only a rename of bicoherence, and it inherits an unaddressed killer: gait harmonics are equally phase-locked to their own fundamental and gait cadence routinely coincides with heart rate during exercise, so the proposed discriminant measures self-coherence that the artifact also possesses.
